---
applyTo: "**/*.Report/definition/**/*.json"
---
PBIR rules: keep the `$schema` versions already used in this report (never bump to newer versions);
page/visual `name` is a unique 20-char hex id equal to its folder name; reference model fields exactly
(`Entity` = table, `Property` = column or measure, `queryRef` = `Table.Field`); keep
`pages/pages.json` pageOrder in sync; never remove the `Documentação` page; native visuals only unless
`trabalho-da-ia/desenho.md` justifies a custom visual. Pages with the text `PROTÓTIPO` are generated by
`pbw prototipo`: replace them by real pages (same name, no `PROTÓTIPO` text) when building the report.
After editing run `pbw validar <dashboard>`: a broken JSON means the analyst cannot open the report.
